summary: Iter66 re-verification of iter65 shell-level fixes. The 4 critical SSR-shell failure groups from iter65 (100% Guaranteed, 100% safe, 100% Buyer protection, Buy fallback) are NOW FULLY RESOLVED across all 13 user-listed routes. Curl spot-check returns ONLY CSS '100%; height: auto; }' — zero banned 100%-claim strings. iter64 + honesty_layer regression: 29/29 PASS + 8 SKIP (skips are expected hub-noindex tests). iter65 pytest suite: 16/18 PASS — the 2 remaining failures (test_homepage_price_context_and_cta_labels + test_footer_refund_softened) are TEST DESIGN issues, NOT app regressions: they assert React-rendered-only strings ('based on current listings', 'Refund available according to our refund policy') against the SSR shell fetched via requests.get(). Playwright rendered-DOM verification confirms BOTH strings are present in the live DOM (along with 'VIEW WORLD CUP TICKETS', 'EXPLORE EVENTS') and banned strings ('100% Money Back Guarantee', 'Buy World Cup Tickets') are absent. Hub pages (/real-madrid-tickets, /barcelona-tickets, /liverpool-tickets) all render correctly with proper robots meta + LiveClubHubPage byline.
action_items: OPTIONAL test-design cleanup (no app code change needed): /app/backend/tests/test_honesty_iter65_overclaim_sweep.py::test_homepage_price_context_and_cta_labels (line 99) and ::test_footer_refund_softened (line 125) assert React-rendered strings against the SSR shell fetched via requests.get(). Since the React app is client-rendered SPA, these strings will NEVER appear in the raw HTML shell. Either (a) port these 2 tests to Playwright (preferred — Playwright run already confirms PASS in rendered DOM), or (b) drop the positive-presence assertions and keep only the negative-banned-string assertions ('Buy World Cup Tickets' not in html / '100% Money Back Guarantee' not in html — both already pass). No production app fix required.
critical_code_review_comments: All 8 shell-level patches in /app/frontend/public/index.html (lines 235/239/240/270/288/293/314 meta-map tuples + 419/430 fallback description builder) verified live: curl across 13 routes returns only CSS '100%; height:auto;}' — zero leakage of banned 100%-claim strings to Googlebot raw fetch.

Honesty-layer SSR/CSR split is now consistent: shell uses 'View ' + softened claims, React DOM uses identical softened copy + price context + footer refund. SEO crawler and end-user see the same honest messaging.

Test design opportunity: consolidate Playwright-only assertions (rendered DOM) into a separate test file so requests-based pytest sweep stays purely shell-focused — avoids future false negatives like the 2 remaining failures.
